title: OauthGrantRevoked
description: A grant chain was revoked. `resident_initiated` is carried explicitly rather than inferred from `reason`, because whether the data subject asked is the legally significant fact and should not require reading an enum correctly.

subject_ref.description: Pairwise pseudonym of the data subject. Subject whose grant was revoked.

grant_id.description: Grant being revoked. Matches a prior oauth-grant-authorised.

reason.description: Why the grant was revoked. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

resident_initiated.description: True when the data subject asked. Carried explicitly because it is the legally significant fact.

scopes.description: Scopes that were revoked, sealed as at authorisation time.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
